scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is specific to the Heawood graph and the loopless five-cycle. Exhaustive finite enumeration establishes the vertex count, complete recoloring graph, connectivity, and diameter; the circle homotopy type then uses the published cycle-codomain component criterion. No family-level, equivariant, or independent-validation claim is made, and unindexed prior computations remain a literature risk.
title: The Heawood-to-\(C_5\) Hom complex is a circle
